model: a = g B F(A AP1), D(lambda) = base(lambda) + delta + sum(a_i*d_i(lambda)); lamp scaled by10**delta. F is the shared forward characteristic.
units: Source effective dye spectra divided by positive native peaks; a is peak-OD contribution, not chemical concentration. Signed effective coefficients/spectra retained. Delta is fixed neutral density, not a stock measurement.
objective: Common-luminance D65 Lab hue directions and broad hue/exposure-group mean log colour-strength ratios against contrast-adjusted ACES. Equal three-paper/group weighting and equal dimensionless terms, without a coloured-lightness residual or per-patch chroma matching.

reference.DRT: pinned ACES2, 100nit DisplayP3; inverse is scalar neutral-luminance bisection, not inverse scene/negative reconstruction
reference.contrast_only: one common scalar curve; copy luminance contrast, not paper neutral tint
reference.input_endpoint_policy: nonpositive components use c(0); above frozen LUT input maximum use final endpoint
reference.paper_calibration: Frozen from Endura's paper-only neutral ramp at Antitone 3baaf074 with its Academy/MRE adapter. Defines contrast only; kept fixed while fitting these matrices, not regenerated from the fitted model.

neutral_gain: Global g1.1908250918396057 calibrated on neutral contrast; base unchanged during colour fit, fixed printing recomputed once per g.

fitting.family: Two unit-row-sum matrices; pre off-diagonal range +/-0.1; nonnegative pre-drives/amounts on144trainingcontrols only. These are calibration choices, not physical laws.
fitting.method: SLSQP finite differences from calibrated and identity starts; both converged. Selected by training loss only, without photograph-based selection or a global-optimum claim.
fitting.reference_eligibility: Original rendered reference L in[15,90] and common-luminance C>=10; candidate colour does not select controls.
fitting.groups: Nonempty reference hue bins of60degrees crossed with input EV-2,0,+2; equal group and medium weights.
fitting.direction_term: Mean squared distance between unit Lab(a,b) vectors, averaged over points within each group.
fitting.strength_term: Square of the group mean log((C+1e-8)/(C_reference+1e-8)), not mean per-point squared chroma error.
fitting.neutral_calibration: Unchanged density gain, characteristic and unit-row-sum neutral response. Extra neutral filtration is compensated by lamp intensity before preflash, not a colour or contrast stage.

normalization.meaning: Fixed passive spectral-filter realization over authored input cube; not source-stock chemistry or a claim outside that domain. Algebraically identical paper dose with reciprocal lamp compensation.
